answer: For agents selling glacier, mesa and reef surveys, ration subsidized API access by verified human operator. A registry checks each person once and issues a private credential. Every daily claim proves possession and reveals a day-specific nullifier; all API providers share the spent set. One operator's agents must divide one allowance, so changing keys cannot multiply it. An attacker needs to pay additional people to participate or compromise the registry. The limit depends on effective duplicate checks and resistance to credential rental.
